purpose: A Switch with its label, an optional description and a footer in one row; clicking the text toggles the switch. Use it for one labelled setting that applies immediately.

notFor.case: A switch whose label lives elsewhere, such as in a table cell.
A choice that only applies after Save or Submit.
Picking one option out of several.

Default.visual: Label Content/primary, description Content/secondary, footer Content/subtle.

Disabled.visual: Label, description and footer Content/disabled; the switch takes Switch Disabled.

Invalid.visual: Footer Status/critical/content; label and description as Default.

Loading.visual: A Spinner replaces the switch; label, description and footer keep their Default roles.

a11y.role: switch (the row is a <label htmlFor> around it; description and footer are aria-describedby)
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the switch. Space or Enter toggles it (Radix Switch). A click on the text toggles it.
notes: Hover and Focused belong to the nested Switch.

openQuestions: Motion: the State axis (Default · Disabled · Invalid · Loading) has no motion decision and recipes/motion.ts has no entry. Should the swap to the Spinner animate? (finding MOT-002 SwitchGroup)
Loading: is the control focusable and announced while the Spinner replaces it, and does focus return to the switch afterwards? The contract does not say.
